name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Oxygen Generator EOG-2
product_name: Zheng-Dao Heavy Industries Emergency Oxygen Generator EOG-2
description: A chemical oxygen generator that produces breathable air through an exothermic chemical reaction, providing 2 hours of oxygen in a device the size of a water bottle. The EOG-2 is activated by pulling a pin that initiates a sodium chlorate decomposition reaction, releasing oxygen at a controlled rate through a breathing mask. The device does not require power, has a 10-year shelf life, and operates in any environment including underwater, in toxic atmospheres, and in vacuum. It is emergency life support reduced to its simplest possible form.
story_hooks: A group trapped in a sealed room after a building collapse survived for 4 hours using EOG-2 units — the oxygen generators kept them alive until rescue, but the exothermic reaction raised the room temperature dangerously.
EOG-2 units have been weaponized — the sodium chlorate reaction core, if breached and mixed with organic material, becomes an incendiary device capable of starting intense fires.

physical_description.visual_profile: Cylindrical canister resembling a high-end water bottle, with a domed safety cap at the top. The body tapers slightly toward the base. Industrial, utilitarian aesthetic with premium finish suggesting life-critical function.
physical_description.weight_description: 0.8 kg — handheld, fits securely in tactical vest pouch or emergency kit
physical_description.primary_material: Aerospace-grade aluminum alloy housing with reinforced steel collar
physical_description.finish: Brushed metallic with anodized thermal-resistant coating; matte non-reflective surface to reduce glint
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal grey body with high-visibility safety orange band wrapping the upper third; chrome accent collar ring
physical_description.interface_elements: Prominent red safety pin with pull-ring lanyard at top; integrated pressure gauge dial (0-3 bar) on upper shoulder; silicone breathing mask with quick-detach coupling mounted along lower body; small printed activation instructions on side panel
distinctive_features: Dual activation modes: standard pull-pin and emergency hard-pull override
Integrated flow-control dial with three settings (slow/normal/emergency)
Micro-LED indicator that glows green during oxygen output, red when depleted
Hydrophobic inlet valve with salt-water erosion resistance
Thermally insulated grip section with diamond-pattern texture
Mandarin and English labels reflecting Zheng-Dao's Pan-Asian origin
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: ZHENG-DAO HEAVY INDUSTRIES stamped in serif font across upper band; holographic authenticity seal; batch code engraved; GLMZ regulatory compliance stamp (Φ certified); manufacturing date in year-month format
physical_description.condition_typical: Clean, pristine condition when unopened; slight residual heat on exterior post-activation; breathing mask seals stored in sealed pouch attached to side
